description: Register a JiraResource wrapping the Jira Python client for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_token_env_var.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding Jira API token

email_env_var.label: Email Env Var
email_env_var.description: Env var holding the Atlassian account email (Basic auth username).

base_url.label: Base Url
base_url.description: Jira instance URL, e.g. https://<workspace>.atlassian.net (no trailing slash).

name: Jira Resource
